purpose: Test the Windows combo-mode MISC1 values for iris upper PHY2 lanes 3/4 while keeping regulator load votes and the CSID3 PHY clock gate active.
analysis_source: FINDINGS.md section 14 static disassembly analysis supplied by the user; not treated as a phone measurement.
test_plan: Baseline: csi-trial settle=22 with regulator load votes enabled.
Variant: after msm_csiphy_lane_config(), set PHY2 base+0xE8 to 0x06 and base+0x128 to 0x0A; verify both readbacks.
Because the variant produced clean packets, repeat it once. Do not run the additional CFG1/2/4/5 variant or any boost-bypass vote.
conclusion: The baseline produced zero CSID3 packets. The MISC1-only variant produced 12677 packets on the first run and 12720 on repeat, each with zero ECC and CRC. The per-lane MISC1 readbacks were 0x06 and 0x0A. This establishes repeatable CSID3 packet reception on the iris upper combo lanes. It does not yet establish Android frame delivery, a visible iris image, or authentication.
publication: local only; no Git push or PR
